# Shizuku Android Apps & No-Root Power-User Tools

> The authoritative open-source catalog of 540+ verified Android apps leveraging the Shizuku privileged API framework to provide root-like capabilities without device rooting. Maintained by Krishna (@kk3163019).

## Overview
Shizuku is an open-source framework developed by Rikka that allows non-rooted Android applications to access privileged system APIs via ADB (Android Debug Bridge) or root. This directory contains curated tools, automated APK mirrors, SHA-256 integrity checksums, VirusTotal security scans, and installation guides.

## Key Recommended Apps by Category

### Debloating & System Cleanup
- Canta (io.github.samolego.canta): Uninstall and disable system bloatware safely via Shizuku. Works with Universal Android Debloater (UAD) lists.
- Uraam: Universal shell toolkit for debloating, app backup, and package management.
- Debloat-HyperOS-App: Tailored for Xiaomi and HyperOS devices without requiring root.

### App Management & Freezing
- Hail: Freeze, disable, and hide unused background apps to save battery and RAM.
- App Manager (io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager): Full-featured open-source package manager with Shizuku backend for permission control, AppOps, and tracker blocking.
- AppOpsX / AppOpsNext: Granular runtime permission and AppOps manager.

### Firewall & Networking
- Athena: Global system DNS and firewall manager without requiring local VPN slots.
- NetCordon: Rootless Android firewall powered by Shizuku; auto-cuts background data on app exit.

### Automation & Power Tools
- Termux with rish: Execute privileged ADB shell commands directly in local terminal sessions.
- MacroDroid / Tasker (with Shizuku plugin): Automate airplane mode, GPS, battery tweaks, and system settings.

### Customization & System Tuning
- ShizukuPlus: Multi-backend provider combining Dhizuku and Shizuku with app-hiding and anti-detection.
- Sui: Modern root companion for Shizuku on Magisk and KernelSU devices.
